telegram.name: Telegram Notifications
telegram.description: Receive notifications on Telegram when you claim drops.
setup_steps: Go to @BotFather on Telegram
Create a new bot with /newbot command
Save the bot token you receive
Start your new bot by searching for it and clicking /start (or send any message)
Get your Chat ID by opening this URL in browser (replace TOKEN): https://api.telegram.org/botTOKEN/getUpdates
Find your user ID in the response - it's the number in "from": {"id": YOUR_ID}
Enter the token and Chat ID below and click Test Connection
telegram.success: ✓ Telegram connection successful! You will receive drop notifications.
telegram.error: Failed to connect to Telegram. Please check your bot token and chat ID.
telegram.missing_credentials: Please fill in both Bot Token and Chat ID. See setup instructions in the Help tab.
telegram.save_error: Failed to save Telegram settings. Please try again.
telegram.credentials_help: Leave the token blank to keep the saved token. To disable notifications, clear the Chat ID and save.

help.about_text: This application automatically mines timed Twitch drops without downloading stream data.
how_to_use_items: Login using your Twitch account (OAuth device code flow)
The miner will automatically discover campaigns and start mining
Configure priority games in Settings to focus on what you want
Monitor progress in the Main and Inventory tabs
important_notes_items: Do not watch streams on the same account while mining
Requires linked game accounts for drops
